title: From 2.1M Hours of Raw Broadcast Audio to Finnish Speech SSL: Confidence Filtering and Architectural Analysis at Scale
abstract: arXiv:2610.13102v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Broadcast archives offer scale and diversity for self-supervised learning (SSL) but contain substantial noisy, non-speech, and multilingual content. Prior work typically relies on voice activity detection or language identification (LID) to extract speech, ensuring presence rather than quality. Whether and how to filter unlabeled speech by quality for SSL, particularly from noisy broadcasts, remains underexplored. We present a large-scale Finnish SSL study starting from 2.1M hours of unconstrained broadcast audio. We propose automatic speech recognition (ASR) confidence as a proxy for pretraining data quality and show 3-7% relative WER improvements over LID-based filtering despite a smaller training set. We further address the lack of controlled architectural comparisons in speech SSL by evaluating Transformer, Macaron-Net, Conformer, and E-Branchformer at matched parameter budgets. translated_title: 从210万小时原始广播音频到芬兰语语音自监督学习：大规模置信度过滤与架构分析
translated_abstract: 广播档案为自监督学习（SSL）提供了规模和多样性，但其中包含大量噪声、非语音和多语言内容。先前的工作通常依赖语音活动检测或语言识别（LID）来提取语音，这只能保证语音的存在而非质量。是否以及如何按质量过滤无标注语音用于SSL，尤其是来自嘈杂广播的语音，仍然缺乏深入研究。我们提出了一项大规模芬兰语SSL研究，从210万小时无约束的广播音频出发。我们提出将自动语音识别（ASR）置信度作为预训练数据质量的代理指标，结果显示尽管训练集更小，相比基于LID的过滤方法仍可获得3-7%的相对词错误率（WER）改进。我们进一步解决了语音SSL领域缺乏受控架构比较的问题，在相同参数预算下评估了Transformer、Macaron-Net、Conformer和E-Branchformer。我们的模型超越了先前的芬兰语SSL基线。
tldr: 该论文提出以ASR置信度作为数据质量过滤标准，从210万小时芬兰语广播音频中筛选高质量语音进行自监督学习预训练，在更小的训练集上相比基于LID的过滤方法取得3-7%的相对WER提升，并系统比较了四种SSL架构的性能。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes using ASR confidence as a data quality filtering criterion for SSL pretraining on 2.1M hours of Finnish broadcast audio, achieving 3-7% relative WER improvements over LID-based filtering with a smaller training set, along with controlled comparisons of four SSL architectures.
